question: From the top 10 instance display names (matching the pattern 'prime') with the highest number of instance info cache records, show only those instances that are not deleted and are running on host "blaze8-12", and display the instance display name, cache record count, VM state, memory in MB, cached network_info JSON, and the dense-rank window column. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH top10 AS (
  SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_record_count
  FROM instances i
  JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.display_name LIKE '%prime%'
  GROUP BY i.display_name
  ORDER BY cache_record_count DESC
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT
  i.display_name,
  t.cache_record_count,
  i.vm_state,
  i.memory_mb,
  iic.network_info,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t.cache_record_count DESC) AS dense_rank_window
FROM top10 t
JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = t.display_name
JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid
WHERE i.deleted = 0
  AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'
ORDER BY t.cache_record_count DESC
